      285: function isAdminHashNow() {
      286:   try {
      287:     const h = String(window.location.hash || "").trim();

      290:     return false;

      294: async function isUidAdmin(uid) {
      295:   const u = String(uid || "").trim();
      296:   if (!u) return false;
      297:   try {
      298:     const ref = doc(db, "admins", u);
      299:     const snap = await getDoc(ref);
      300:     if (!snap.exists()) return false;
      301:     const data = snap.data() || {};
      302:     return data.active !== false;
      303:   } catch {
      304:     return false;
      305:   }
      306: }

      186:  * Aceita:
      187:  * - getAnimalLabel(14)
      188:  * - getAnimalLabel({ grupo: 14 })
      189:  * - getAnimalLabel({ animal: "ÁGUIA" })

      191:  */
      192: export function getAnimalLabel(input = null) {
      193:   // número puro (ou string numérica pura)
      194:   const s = String(input ?? "").trim();
      195:   if (typeof input === "number" || (s && /^\d+$/.test(s))) {
      196:     const byGrupo = getBichoByGrupo(input);
      197:     return byGrupo?.animal ? byGrupo.animal : "";
      198:   }
      199: 
      200:   if (typeof input === "string") {
      201:     const byName = getBichoByAnimalName(input);
      202:     if (byName?.animal) return byName.animal;
      203: 
      204:     const raw = String(input || "").trim();
      205:     return raw ? raw.toUpperCase() : "";
      206:   }
      207: 
      208:   if (input && typeof input === "object") {
      209:     const grupo = input?.grupo ?? null;
      210:     const animal = input?.animal ?? null;
      211: 
      212:     const byGrupo = grupo != null ? getBichoByGrupo(grupo) : null;
      213:     if (byGrupo?.animal) return byGrupo.animal;

>>>   200:     // Se vier com +55 / 55 na frente e total BR internacional

--- linha 6 ---
        1: // src/pages/Account/account.session.js
        2: 
        3: /**
        4:  * Sessão global do app (pp_session_v1)
        5:  * - Fonte de verdade usada pelo App.jsx para decidir login vs dashboard
>>>     6:  * - Dispara evento "pp_session_changed" no mesmo tab
        7:  */
        8: 
        9: import { ACCOUNT_SESSION_KEY, SESSION_CHANGED_EVENT } from "./account.constants";
       10: 
       11: function hasWindow() {
       12:   return typeof window !== "undefined";
       13: }
       14: 
       15: function canUseLocalStorage() {
       16:   if (!hasWindow()) return false;
       17:   try {
       18:     const ls = window.localStorage;
       19:     if (!ls) return false;
       20: 
       21:     // probe rápido para garantir que não é bloqueado (Safari private / políticas)
       22:     const k = "__pp_ls_probe__";
       23:     ls.setItem(k, "1");
       24:     ls.removeItem(k);
       25:     return true;
       26:   } catch {
       27:     return false;
       28:   }
       29: }
       30: 
       31: /* =========================
       32:    Event
       33: ========================= */
       34: 
       35: export function dispatchSessionChanged() {
       36:   try {
       37:     if (!hasWindow()) return;
       38:     window.dispatchEvent(new Event(SESSION_CHANGED_EVENT));
       39:   } catch {}
       40: }
       41: 
       42: /* =========================
       43:    Storage
       44: ========================= */
       45: 
       46: export function safeWriteSession(obj) {
       47:   try {
       48:     if (!canUseLocalStorage()) return;
       49:     window.localStorage.setItem(ACCOUNT_SESSION_KEY, JSON.stringify(obj));
       50:   } catch {}

      475: function clampRangeToBounds(next, minDate, maxDate) {
      476:   const f = next?.from;
      477:   const t = next?.to;
      478: 
      479:   if (!isISODate(f) || !isISODate(t)) return null;
      480:   if (!minDate || !maxDate) return null;
      481:   if (!isISODate(minDate) || !isISODate(maxDate)) return null;
      482: 
      483:   let from = f < minDate ? minDate : f;
      484:   let to = t > maxDate ? maxDate : t;
      485: 
      486:   if (from > to) to = from;
      487:   return { from, to };
      488: }

       31: }

       34:   return String(v ?? "").trim();

       37: function todayYMDLocal() {
       38:   const d = new Date();
       39:   return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(d.getDate())}`;
       40: }
       41: 
       42: function isYMD(s) {
       43:   return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(s || "").trim());
       44: }
       45: 
       46: function ymdToBR(ymd) {
       47:   const m = String(ymd || "")
       48:     .trim()
       49:     .match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
       50:   if (!m) return "";
       51:   return `${m[3]}/${m[2]}/${m[1]}`;
       52: }
       53: 
       54: function ymdToUTCDate(ymd) {
       55:   const m = String(ymd || "").match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
       56:   if (!m) return null;
       57:   return new Date(Date.UTC(Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]) - 1, Number(m[3])));
       58: }
       59: 
       60: function diffDaysUTC(aYmd, bYmd) {
       61:   const a = ymdToUTCDate(aYmd);
       62:   const b = ymdToUTCDate(bYmd);
       63:   if (!a || !b) return NaN;
       64:   return Math.floor((b.getTime() - a.getTime()) / 86400000);
       65: }

      176: function normalizeSingleDateWithBounds(dateIn, minYmd, maxYmd) {
      177:   const d = clampYmd(dateIn, minYmd, maxYmd);
      178:   if (d) return d;
      179: 
      180:   const fallback =
      181:     clampYmd(todayYMDLocal(), minYmd, maxYmd) ||
      182:     (isYMD(maxYmd) ? maxYmd : null) ||
      183:     (isYMD(minYmd) ? minYmd : null) ||
      184:     todayYMDLocal();
      185: 
      186:   return fallback;
      187: }

       44: function normalizeBoundsResponse(b) {
       45:   const minRaw = safeStr(b?.minYmd || b?.minDate || b?.min || "");
       46:   const maxRaw = safeStr(b?.maxYmd || b?.maxDate || b?.max || "");
       47:   const minYmd = isYMD(minRaw) ? minRaw : null;
       48:   const maxYmd = isYMD(maxRaw) ? maxRaw : null;
       49:   return { minYmd, maxYmd, source: safeStr(b?.source || "") };
       50: }

      494: async function runPool(items, worker, concurrency = 3) {
      495:   const queue = [...items];
      496:   const runners = Array.from({ length: Math.max(1, concurrency) }, async () => {
      497:     while (queue.length) {
      498:       const it = queue.shift();
      499:       // eslint-disable-next-line no-await-in-loop
      500:       await worker(it);
      501:     }
      502:   });
      503:   await Promise.all(runners);
      504: }

       32: function findPreviousValidDraw(draws, currentYmd, currentHour) {
       33:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
       34:   const targetY = safeStr(currentYmd);
       35:   const targetH = toHourBucket(currentHour);
       36: 
       37:   if (!isYMD(targetY) || !targetH) return null;
       38: 
       39:   const targetTs = ymdHourToTs(targetY, targetH);
       40: 
       41:   return list
       42:     .filter((draw) => Array.isArray(draw?.prizes) && draw.prizes.length > 0)
       43:     .map((draw) => {
       44:       const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
       45:       const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
       46:       return { draw, ts: ymdHourToTs(y, h) };
       47:     })
       48:     .filter((x) => Number.isFinite(x.ts) && x.ts < targetTs)
       49:     .sort((a, b) => b.ts - a.ts)[0]?.draw || null;
       50: }

       56: function grupoFromDezena2(dezena2) {
       57:   const s = safeStr(dezena2);
       58:   if (!/^\d{2}$/.test(s)) return null;
       59: 
       60:   const n = Number(s);
       61:   if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0 || n > 99) return null;
       62:   if (n === 0) return 25;
       63: 
       64:   const g = Math.ceil(n / 4);
       65:   return g >= 1 && g <= 25 ? g : null;
       66: }

--- linha 703 ---
      683: function computeStructuralBaseDistribution(
      684:   draws,
      685:   lotteryKey,
      686:   targetHour,
      687:   targetDow,
      688:   groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K
      689: ) {
      690:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
      691:   const key = safeStr(lotteryKey).toUpperCase();
      692:   const target = toHourBucket(targetHour);
      693:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
      694: 
      695:   const freq = new Map();
      696:   let totalSamples = 0;
      697: 
      698:   for (const d of list) {
      699:     const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
      700:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
      701:     if (!h || !y) continue;
      702: 
>>>   703:     if (key === "FEDERAL") {
      704:       if (!isFederalDrawDay(y)) continue;
      705:       if (Number(getDowKey(y)) !== Number(targetDow)) continue;
      706:     } else {
      707:       if (h !== target) continue;
      708:     }
      709: 
      710:     const items = getAllTop5Groups(d);
      711:     if (!items.length) continue;
      712: 
      713:     totalSamples += 1;
      714: 
      715:     for (const it of items) {
      716:       const g = Number(it.grupo);
      717:       if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k) continue;
      718:       freq.set(g, Number(freq.get(g) || 0) + 1);
      719:     }
      720:   }
      721: 
      722:   const out = new Map();
      723:   const denom = Math.max(1, totalSamples * 5);
      724: 
      725:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
      726:     const n = Number(freq.get(g) || 0);
      727:     out.set(g, n / denom);
      728:   }
      729: 
      730:   return { scoreProb: out, totalSamples };
      731: }

      737: function sortDrawsAsc(draws) {
      738:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
      739:   return [...list].sort((a, b) => {
      740:     const ya = pickDrawYMD(a);
      741:     const yb = pickDrawYMD(b);
      742:     const ha = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(a));

      727:     out.set(g, n / denom);
      728:   }

       32: function findPreviousValidDraw(draws, currentYmd, currentHour) {
       33:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
       34:   const targetY = safeStr(currentYmd);
       35:   const targetH = toHourBucket(currentHour);
       36: 
       37:   if (!isYMD(targetY) || !targetH) return null;
       38: 
       39:   const targetTs = ymdHourToTs(targetY, targetH);
       40: 
       41:   return list
       42:     .filter((draw) => Array.isArray(draw?.prizes) && draw.prizes.length > 0)
       43:     .map((draw) => {
       44:       const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
       45:       const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
       46:       return { draw, ts: ymdHourToTs(y, h) };
       47:     })
       48:     .filter((x) => Number.isFinite(x.ts) && x.ts < targetTs)

      683: function computeStructuralBaseDistribution(
      684:   draws,
      685:   lotteryKey,
      686:   targetHour,
      687:   targetDow,
      688:   groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K
      689: ) {
      690:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
      691:   const key = safeStr(lotteryKey).toUpperCase();
      692:   const target = toHourBucket(targetHour);
      693:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
      694: 
      695:   const freq = new Map();
      696:   let totalSamples = 0;
      697: 
      698:   for (const d of list) {
      699:     const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
      700:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
      701:     if (!h || !y) continue;
      702: 
>>>   703:     if (key === "FEDERAL") {
      704:       if (!isFederalDrawDay(y)) continue;
      705:       if (Number(getDowKey(y)) !== Number(targetDow)) continue;
      706:     } else {
      707:       if (h !== target) continue;
      708:     }
      709: 
      710:     const items = getAllTop5Groups(d);
      711:     if (!items.length) continue;
      712: 
      713:     totalSamples += 1;
      714: 
      715:     for (const it of items) {
      716:       const g = Number(it.grupo);
      717:       if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k) continue;
      718:       freq.set(g, Number(freq.get(g) || 0) + 1);
      719:     }
      720:   }
      721: 
      722:   const out = new Map();
      723:   const denom = Math.max(1, totalSamples * 5);
      724: 
      725:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
      726:     const n = Number(freq.get(g) || 0);
      727:     out.set(g, n / denom);
      728:   }
      729: 
      730:   return { scoreProb: out, totalSamples };
      731: }

      737: function sortDrawsAsc(draws) {
      738:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
      739:   return [...list].sort((a, b) => {
      740:     const ya = pickDrawYMD(a);
      741:     const yb = pickDrawYMD(b);

      745:     const tsb = ymdHourToTs(yb, hb);
      746:     return tsa - tsb;
      747:   });

     1445: function computeStructuralFirstDistribution(
     1446:   draws,

     1454:   const target = toHourBucket(targetHour);
     1455:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
     1456: 
     1457:   const firstFreq = new Map();
     1458:   let totalSamples = 0;
     1459: 
     1460:   for (const d of list) {
     1461:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);

     1466:       if (!isFederalDrawDay(y)) continue;
     1467:       if (Number(getDowKey(y)) !== Number(targetDow)) continue;
     1468:     } else {
     1469:       if (h !== target) continue;
     1470:     }
     1471:

     1473:     if (!Number.isFinite(Number(g)) || Number(g) < 1 || Number(g) > k) continue;
     1474:

     1476:     firstFreq.set(Number(g), Number(firstFreq.get(Number(g)) || 0) + 1);
     1477:   }
     1478: 
     1479:   const prob = new Map();
     1480:   const denom = Math.max(1, totalSamples);
     1481: 
     1482:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
     1483:     prob.set(g, Number(firstFreq.get(g) || 0) / denom);
     1484:   }
     1485: 
     1486:   return { prob, firstFreq, totalSamples };
     1487: }

       32: function findPreviousValidDraw(draws, currentYmd, currentHour) {
       33:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
       34:   const targetY = safeStr(currentYmd);
       35:   const targetH = toHourBucket(currentHour);
       36: 
       37:   if (!isYMD(targetY) || !targetH) return null;
       38: 
       39:   const targetTs = ymdHourToTs(targetY, targetH);
       40: 
       41:   return list
       42:     .filter((draw) => Array.isArray(draw?.prizes) && draw.prizes.length > 0)
       43:     .map((draw) => {
       44:       const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
       45:       const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
       46:       return { draw, ts: ymdHourToTs(y, h) };
       47:     })
       48:     .filter((x) => Number.isFinite(x.ts) && x.ts < targetTs)
       49:     .sort((a, b) => b.ts - a.ts)[0]?.draw || null;
       50: }

       56: function grupoFromDezena2(dezena2) {
       57:   const s = safeStr(dezena2);
       58:   if (!/^\d{2}$/.test(s)) return null;
       59: 
       60:   const n = Number(s);
       61:   if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0 || n > 99) return null;
       62:   if (n === 0) return 25;
       63: 
       64:   const g = Math.ceil(n / 4);
       65:   return g >= 1 && g <= 25 ? g : null;
       66: }

--- linha 819 ---
      799: function computeStructuralBaseDistribution(
      800:   draws,
      801:   lotteryKey,
      802:   targetHour,
      803:   targetDow,
      804:   groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K
      805: ) {
      806:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
      807:   const key = safeStr(lotteryKey).toUpperCase();
      808:   const target = toHourBucket(targetHour);
      809:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
      810: 
      811:   const freq = new Map();
      812:   let totalSamples = 0;
      813: 
      814:   for (const d of list) {
      815:     const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
      816:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
      817:     if (!h || !y) continue;
      818: 
>>>   819:     if (key === "FEDERAL") {
      820:       if (!isFederalDrawDay(y)) continue;
      821:       if (Number(getDowKey(y)) !== Number(targetDow)) continue;
      822:     } else {
      823:       if (h !== target) continue;
      824:     }
      825: 
      826:     const items = getAllPrizePresenceGroups(d);
      827:     if (!items.length) continue;
      828: 
      829:     totalSamples += 1;
      830: 
      831:     for (const it of items) {
      832:       const g = Number(it.grupo);
      833:       if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k) continue;
      834:       freq.set(g, Number(freq.get(g) || 0) + 1);
      835:     }
      836:   }
      837: 
      838:   const out = new Map();
      839:   const denom = Math.max(1, totalSamples * 5);
      840: 
      841:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
      842:     const n = Number(freq.get(g) || 0);
      843:     out.set(g, n / denom);
      844:   }
      845: 
      846:   return { scoreProb: out, totalSamples };
      847: }

      850:    Recência / pressão estrutural
      851: ========================= */

       17: 
       18: function clampProb(v) {
       19:   const n = Number(v);
       20:   if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return 0;
       21:   if (n > 1) return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, n / 100));
       22:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, n));
       23: }
       24: 
       25: function resolveProbValue(x) {
       26:   return clampProb(x?.scoreProb ?? x?.prob ?? x?.probCond ?? 0);
       27: }
       28: 
       29: function normalizeMilhar4(v) {
       30:   const dig = String(v || "").replace(/\D+/g, "");
       31:   if (!dig) return "";
       32:   return dig.length >= 4 ? dig.slice(-4) : dig.padStart(4, "0");
       33: }
       34: 
       35: function build4ColsFromEngineOut(out, expectedCols = 4, perCol = 5) {
       36:   const dezenas = Array.isArray(out?.dezenas) ? out.dezenas : [];
       37:   const slots = Array.isArray(out?.slots) ? out.slots : [];
       38:   const cols = [];
       39: 
       40:   for (const dz of dezenas.slice(0, expectedCols)) {
       41:     const items = slots
       42:       .filter((s) => String(s?.dezena || "") === String(dz))
       43:       .map((s) => normalizeMilhar4(s?.milhar))
       44:       .map((m) => (/^\d{4}$/.test(m) ? m : ""))
       45:       .slice(0, perCol);
       46: 
       47:     while (items.length < perCol) items.push("");
       48:     cols.push({ dezena: dz, items });

       18: function clampProb(v) {
       19:   const n = Number(v);
       20:   if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return 0;
       21:   if (n > 1) return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, n / 100));
       22:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, n));
       23: }
       24: 
       25: function resolveProbValue(x) {
       26:   return clampProb(x?.scoreProb ?? x?.prob ?? x?.probCond ?? 0);
       27: }
       28: 
       29: function normalizeMilhar4(v) {
       30:   const dig = String(v || "").replace(/\D+/g, "");
       31:   if (!dig) return "";
       32:   return dig.length >= 4 ? dig.slice(-4) : dig.padStart(4, "0");
       33: }
       34: 
       35: function build4ColsFromEngineOut(out, expectedCols = 4, perCol = 5) {
       36:   const dezenas = Array.isArray(out?.dezenas) ? out.dezenas : [];
       37:   const slots = Array.isArray(out?.slots) ? out.slots : [];
       38:   const cols = [];
       39: 
       40:   for (const dz of dezenas.slice(0, expectedCols)) {
       41:     const items = slots
       42:       .filter((s) => String(s?.dezena || "") === String(dz))
       43:       .map((s) => normalizeMilhar4(s?.milhar))
       44:       .map((m) => (/^\d{4}$/.test(m) ? m : ""))
       45:       .slice(0, perCol);
       46: 
       47:     while (items.length < perCol) items.push("");
       48:     cols.push({ dezena: dz, items });
       49:   }

       27: function drawTs(draw) {
       28:   const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
       29:   const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
       30:   if (!y || !h) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
       31: 
       32:   const [Y, M, D] = y.split("-").map(Number);
       33:   const base = Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D);
       34:   const mins = hourToInt(h);
       35:   const add = mins >= 0 ? mins * 60 * 1000 : 0;
       36:   return base + add;
       37: }

       40:   const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
       41:   const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
       42:   if (!y || !h) return "";
       43:   return `${y}|${h}`;
       44: }

       47:   const map = new Map();
       48:

       50:     const key = drawKey(d);
       51:     if (!key) continue;
       52:     if (!map.has(key)) map.set(key, d);
       53:   }

       27: function drawTs(draw) {
       28:   const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
       29:   const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
       30:   if (!y || !h) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
       31: 
       32:   const [Y, M, D] = y.split("-").map(Number);
       33:   const base = Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D);
       34:   const mins = hourToInt(h);
       35:   const add = mins >= 0 ? mins * 60 * 1000 : 0;
       36: 
       37:   return base + add;
       38: }
       39: 
       40: function drawKey(draw) {
       41:   const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
       42:   const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
       43:   if (!y || !h) return "";
       44:   return `${y}|${h}`;
       45: }
       46: 
       47: function dedupeAndSort(draws) {
       48:   const map = new Map();
       49: 
       50:   for (const d of Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : []) {
       51:     const key = drawKey(d);
       52:     if (!key) continue;
       53:     if (!map.has(key)) map.set(key, d);
       54:   }
       55: 
       56:   return Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) => drawTs(a) - drawTs(b));
       57: }

      208:

      210:   if (mISO) return `${pad2(mISO[1])}:${pad2(mISO[2])}`;
      211:

      213:   if (mHm) {
      214:     const hh = String(mHm[1]).slice(0, -2);
      215:     const mm = String(mHm[1]).slice(-2);
      216:     if (/^\d{1,2}$/.test(hh) && /^\d{2}$/.test(mm)) {
      217:       return `${pad2(hh)}:${mm}`;
      218:     }
      219:   }
      220: 
      221:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
      222:   if (m2) return `${pad2(m2[1])}:00`;
      223: 
      224:   return s0.trim();

     1245:   return `range::${scopeKey}::${from}..${to}::pos=${p}::h=${h}::mode=${m}`;
     1246: }

       45: function brToYMD(br) {
       46:   const m = String(br || "")
       47:     .trim()
       48:     .match(/^(\d{2})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{4})$/);

       59:     )}`;

       64:     const d = input.toDate();
